# Test fixtures

## `synthetic-spectora-like.xlsx` — SYNTHETIC, NOT A REAL SPECTORA EXPORT

This file is hand-generated by
[`scripts/generate-synthetic-fixture.ts`](../../scripts/generate-synthetic-fixture.ts)
(`npx tsx scripts/generate-synthetic-fixture.ts` to regenerate). It exists
only so the import pipeline has something to run against while a real
Spectora "Export to spreadsheet → Export HTML Text" file is still missing
from this repository (see
[`sample-data/spectora/README.md`](../../sample-data/spectora/README.md)).

It is **not** derived from real customer data, and it is **not** a
verified example of Spectora's actual export format — its structure is an
informed guess, documented as such in
[`docs/spectora-format.md`](../../docs/spectora-format.md). Do not use it as
evidence that the parser handles real Spectora exports; it only proves the
parser handles *this* assumed shape.

It deliberately exercises: a non-header preamble row, blank-filled
hierarchy grouping, a fully blank spacer row, allowlisted rich-text
formatting (bold/italic/line-break/list/link), a disallowed tag that must
be stripped (`<script>`), an unsafe link scheme that must be dropped
(`javascript:`), an item with no comment (absent in source, not an
importer failure), an unmapped extra column with a value (flagged, not
dropped), and a comment appearing before any item exists in a new section
(ambiguous hierarchy, flagged rather than silently mis-attached).
